dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 确认必改意见，并说明处理与复核步骤。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Make named learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI marks allowed. Scene: Two adult stick figures at a small table reviewing a single large paper checklist flat in foreground center. Rectangular sheet has four empty square checkboxes and short plain horizontal placeholder lines, no letters. Developer indicates sheet with a pen held above it; reviewer points at a monitor behind showing abstract rectangles. Entire checklist unobscured and not crossed by arms.

coverage_review.scope: W044 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W044.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：开发者记录检查项并听取评审意见，前景纸质清单四个复选框和边界清楚；必改要求与具体评论由对白提供，不从无文字屏幕推断。
